checkedAlternates.resolution: The power set P({1, 2}) = {∅, {1}, {2}, {1, 2}} has 2² = 4 elements (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Union symbol ∪ can be visually confused with intersection ∩ ({1, 2} ∩ {2} has 1 element).
checkedAlternates.resolution: Union combines all elements, so {1, 2} ∪ {2} = {1, 2} has cardinality 2 (group-3), not 1 (group-2).
